description: Run by the homelab Renovate workflow (homelab/.forgejo/workflows/renovate.yml).

flake.lock pins every tool in the package, so the weekly lock file maintenance PR is the tool bump. Do not merge it before the check workflow is green: tests/integration.sh fails when the new biome needs a configs/biome.json migration (schema version, deprecated fields). Run biome migrate on the branch, then check that rules.preset is still "recommended".

packageRules.description: Majors are reviewed one at a time
The CI image tag is bumped by hand together with the nix-store volume name in .forgejo/workflows/check.yml (homelab/docs/ci.md)
